data.name: Faqir
data.gender_notes: Faqir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is poor or needy, but rich in faith and piety. The name Faqir carries the meaning “Poor, destitute, needy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faqir usually hope their child will grow to embody poor, destitute, needy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is content with what Allah has decreed and has complete trust in Him.
data.etymology: Faqir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Poor, destitute, needy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faqir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فقير
in_arabic.meaning: صاحب الفقر، شخص فقير، محتاج، ذليل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفقير هو الشخص الذي يفتقر إلى المال أو السلطة أو المكانة الاجتماعية، وهو الشخص الذي يعتمد على الآخرين للحصول على المساعدة، وقد ورد ذكر الفقراء في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، مثل قوله تعالى: «وَيُعطِ الفَقِيرَ وَالمَسكينَ وَلاَ يَكِلُ التَصريفَ إِلَيهِ مَدى الأَيامِ»

in_urdu.name: فقیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: فقیر وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جس کے پاس کچھ نہیں ہوتا، یا جو کسی چیز سے محروم ہوتا ہے، فقیر کا ذکر اردو شاعری میں بھی کیا گیا ہے، خاص طور پر صوفی شاعری میں، جہاں فقیر کو روحانی سفر پر ایک شخصیت کے طور پر پیش کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़क़ीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़क़ीर वह व्यक्ति होता है जिसके पास कुछ नहीं होता है, या जो किसी चीज़ से वंचित होता है, फ़क़ीर की अवधारणा हिंदू धर्म और इस्लाम दोनों में पाई जाती है, जहां यह एक आध्यात्मिक यात्रा पर एक व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है

in_pashto.name: فقیر

data.cultural_impact: The name Faqir holds a place of reverence and respect in Islamic culture. It is often associated with individuals who dedicate their lives to seeking knowledge, spiritual growth, and serving the community. Faqirs are considered to be pious, humble, and selfless individuals who have renounced worldly possessions and material wealth in order to gain a deeper understanding of God and spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Faqir holds a deep spiritual significance for Muslims. It is a reminder of the importance of faith and piety in the face of material wealth and worldly desires. By choosing to identify oneself as a Faqir, one is making a deliberate decision to prioritize the pursuit of spiritual growth and knowledge over the accumulation of material possessions.
